The '''''Panorama''''' was a [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]]. While touring through the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]], the future [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Technician/Legends|technician]] [[Ral Shawgrim]] was born onboard while his [[Parent/Legends|parents]] were on vacation.
